summary: @servicetitan/microfront preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against `math_init.js`, a 727KB single-line obfuscated `@bun-cjs` module shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` uses obfuscator.io-style rotating string-array construction (`WV8StW` shuffle over a large mixed constant table `n7gIxM`) plus a base64-alphabet decoder (`hc1jfK9`), and its filename is unrelated to the advertised React micro-frontend purpose. Executing the payload specifically under Bun (rather than Node) bypasses Node-based runtime introspection. The package publishes under the `@servicetitan` scope with a `servicetitan/playground` repo URL but ships only a minimal `lib/` React surface alongside this install-time dropper, consistent with scope impersonation of the ServiceTitan organization. Installing the package on default `npm install` fetches an alternate runtime and runs an opaque, obfuscated in-package payload the installer has not consented to, with no relation to the stated functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
